blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍T -Search, 一个开放量级的代理检索器 进行硬多步搜索。 鉴于一个问题和一个搜索工具在一个固定的元件上,它运行一个有界限的多轮搜索,并返回一个有短理由的分级证据块列表,将答案生成留给下游模型,因此后端和生成器可以互换而无需再培训. T-Search以Qune3.6-35B-A3B为基础,并接受过关于对抗性过滤合成搜索任务的培训,经过圆形的有监督的微调,然后普惠制O进行召回奖励。 平均有7个附有黄金证据说明的英文和俄文基准,达到56.0Recall@10,推出1个,高出基数14.4分;61.3,推出3个引信,超过较大的开放型号。 我们发布模型,使用,现场演示,以及三个基准,包括TRuST,这是第一个本土-俄罗斯的硬搜索基准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) assumes that the answer can be found by querying the question as posed. Multi-hop questions broke this assumption with HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , and iterative retrieve-and-reason methods followed ( Press et al., 2023 ; Trivedi et al., 2023 ) ; BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and its fixed-corpus variant BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) push the setting to questions whose search terms do not appear in the question, so answering requires discovering an entity the question never names and rejecting documents that look relevant but are not. Deep-research agents ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Tongyi DeepResearch Team, 2025 ) handle this with long tool-calling trajectories on large models, which is slow and expensive, and are evaluated on the final answer, which conflates retrieval with generation.
blocks.zh: Retrival-augmented generation (Lewis et al., 2020) 假设通过询问提出的问题可以找到答案. 多跳问题与HotpotQA(Yang等,2018年)打破了这一假设,并遵循了迭接回和推理方法(Press等,2023;Trivedi等,2023年);浏览Comp(Wei等,2025年)及其固定子公司变体浏览Comp-Plus(Chen等,2025年)将设定推向搜索术语未出现在问题中的问题,因此回答需要发现一个实体从不问问题,并拒绝看起来相关但无关的文件. 深海研究剂(Jin等,2025;Li等,2025;Tongyi深海研究) Team, 2025 (Team, 2025 ))在大型模型上用长长的工具调用轨迹来处理这个,这个轨迹既慢又昂贵,在最后的答案上被评价,这把检索与生成混为一谈.

blocks.en: T-Search targets the retrieval stage in isolation. Given a question and a search backend, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks, each with a one-line reason, for a downstream model of the user’s choice to answer from. It never writes the answer, so one retriever serves many generators; it reaches documents only through the search tool, so the backend can be swapped without retraining; and it returns chunk identifiers, so its quality is measured directly as recall of gold evidence rather than through an answer judge. Three design choices make this work: short, bounded rounds in a ReAct loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) that carry forward only explicitly saved evidence, so tool output does not accumulate and degrade the model’s judgment ( Hong et al., 2025 ) ; search difficulty engineered into the training data and verified by adversarial solvers; and a recall reward on chunk identifiers with no judge model, optimized with GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: T-Search孤立地瞄准了检索阶段. 考虑到一个问题和一个搜索后端,它运行一个有界限的多轮搜索,并返回一个排行榜上的证据块列表,每个块都有一行理由,用于用户选择的下游模式的答案. 它从来不写答案,因此一个检索器服务于许多生成器;它只能通过搜索工具到达文档,因此后端可以互换而无需再培训;它返回块标识符,因此其质量直接被测量为对黄金证据的召回,而不是通过一个答案裁判. 三项设计选择使这项工作得以完成:短而有限度的回合在一个ReAct循环中(姚等,2023年),只传递明确保存的证据,因此工具输出不会积累并降低模型的判断力(洪等,2025年;搜索难度被设计入培训数据并由对抗方解析器验证;对没有法官模型的块状识别器进行召回奖励,与普惠制O进行优化(郑等,2025年)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , WebDancer, WebSailor, WebShaper ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) , and Tongyi DeepResearch ( Tongyi DeepResearch Team, 2025 ) are trained end-to-end over a growing transcript and judged on the final answer, which conflates retrieval with generation. The concurrent Harness-1 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) is closest to T-Search: a 20B retrieval subagent trained with RL inside a harness that returns curated evidence rather than an answer. The two divide labor between environment and model in opposite directions. Harness-1 keeps a candidate pool, evidence graph, and verification records in the environment and re-renders them into the context every turn, shaping behavior through a multi-term reward; T-Search carries saved evidence, round summaries, coverage declarations, and goals into each new round, so a chunk survives only if the policy saves it, and a single trajectory-level recall reward suffices. Harness-1 is also English-only and its released search tool relies on an external embedding API, whereas T-Search is bilingual and treats the backend as a swappable component. Section 6 evaluates all six baseline agents over the same fixed indices.
blocks.zh: Search-R1 (Jin等,2025年),WebDancer,WebSailor,WebShaper (Wu等,2025年;Li等,2025年;Tao等,2026年;Tongyi DeepResearch (Tongyi DeepResearch Team,2025年)) 被训练出端到端由不断增长的笔录来判断,最后的答案将检索与生成相融合. 并发的Harness-1(Jiang等,2026年)最接近于T-Search:一个20B回取子剂在回取被整理出的证据而不是答案的绳索内经过RL训练. 两者将劳动分为环境与模型两个相反的方向. Harness-1在环境中保留一个候选集合,证据图表,以及核查记录,并将记录重新放入上下文,通过多期奖励塑造行为;T-Search将被保存的证据,回合摘要,覆盖声明,以及目标带入了每轮新回合,因此只有政策保存了它,一个块才能活下来,而单一的轨迹级召回奖励就足够了. Harness-1也只使用英语,其所发布的搜索工具依赖于外部嵌入的API,而T-Search是双语的并视后端为可互换组件. 第6节根据相同的固定指数评价所有6个基线代理人。

blocks.en: We adopt the fixed-index, gold-evidence design of BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) and contribute TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark, and the bilingual SynthComp. Open Russian-language releases have so far targeted general reasoning and efficient inference ( Stoianov et al., 2026 ) rather than multi-step retrieval. Short clean rounds with model-controlled saving sit between external memory ( Packer et al., 2023 ) and summarization, avoiding both re-fetching and lossy rewrites where added context degrades judgment ( Hong et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们采用固定索引、黄金证据设计浏览器Comp-Plus(Chen等,2025年)和SealQA(Pham等,2026年),并为TRuST(第一个本土-俄罗斯硬搜索基准)和双语SynthComp作出贡献。 开放的俄语版到目前为止已经针对一般推理和高效推论(Stoianov等,2026年),而不是多步检索. 短而清洁的回合由模型控制的保存坐落于外部内存(Packer等,2023年)和总结相接之间,避免了在附加上下文会降低判断力的重复和失落重写(Hong等,2025年).

blocks.en: 3 System Overview
blocks.zh: 3 系统概览

blocks.en: Figure 1: T-Search and its playground. The policy searches a selected backend, carries explicit memory between rounds, and returns ranked evidence. Optional parallel rollouts are fused with RRF. The playground displays the search trace, while a separate downstream model generates the answer. Fixed-index evaluation uses corpus backends; live web search is available in the demo.
blocks.zh: 图1:T-Search及其游乐场。 策略搜索一个选定的后端,在回合之间带有明确的内存,并返回排序的证据. 可选的平行推出与RRF相结合。 游乐场显示搜索痕迹,而单独的下游模式则生成答案. 固定索引评价使用实体后端;演示中提供现场网页搜索。

blocks.en: Given a question and a search backend, the policy operates through three tools: search_corpus , save_and_advance , and finalize_ranking . Within a round, it issues queries, inspects returned chunks, and follows intermediate entities or unresolved constraints. To continue in a fresh context, it selects chunks to retain with a reason for each, records which parts of the question are covered or unresolved, and supplies a round summary and a goal for the next round. The harness constructs the next input from the original question, saved chunks, round summaries, coverage state, and next-round goal (Figure 1 ). The preceding tool transcript and full reasoning history are discarded.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个问题和一个搜索后端,该政策通过三个工具运作: search_corpus, save_ and_advance, 并最后确定_ 排名. 在一轮内,它发出询问,检查退回的块并跟踪中间实体或尚未解决的制约因素。 为了在新的背景下继续,它选择保留块并列出每个块的理由,记录问题中哪些部分被涵盖或尚未解决,并为下一轮提供一个回合摘要和一个目标。 牵引装置构建出原题的下个输入,保存出块,圆形摘要,覆盖状态,下个回合入球(图1). 前面的工具记录和完整的推理历史被抛弃.

blocks.en: The default configuration permits up to five rounds, each with a context budget of about 32k tokens. At 75% of that budget, search is locked. Advancing requires at least five searches and one saved chunk. Before the last allowed round, finalization is rejected if at least half of the declared question parts remain unresolved. In the last round, advancing is disabled and the coverage restriction on finalization is lifted. Appendix F gives the complete tool schemas, prompts, and validation rules.
blocks.zh: 默认配置允许最多5发,每发的上下文预算约为32克令牌. 占预算的75% 搜索被锁定 推进需要至少5个搜索和一个保存的块 。 在最后一轮允许的回合之前,如果至少一半已宣布的问题部分仍未得到解决,则最后敲定将被拒绝。 在最后一轮中,取消了推进,取消了对最后敲定的覆盖范围限制。 附 录 F给出了完整的工具计划,提示和验证规则.

blocks.en: On successful finalization, the policy supplies a ranking with reasons and coverage declarations, using saved evidence or chunks retrieved in the current round. The harness exports at most ten chunks; Appendix F describes fallback behavior when no finalization is accepted. Three parallel rollouts can be combined by reciprocal rank fusion ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) , followed by truncation to ten chunks; Section 6 evaluates the latency–recall trade-off.
blocks.zh: 政策一旦成功定稿,将利用本轮中保存的证据或收集的块,提供附有理由和覆盖面申报的排名。 牵引出量最多为十块;附录F描述了在不接受最后敲定时的倒置行为。 三个平行的推出可以由对等的等级组合(Cormack等,2009年)结合起来,然后缩短为10个块;第6节评价了延迟-召回取舍。

blocks.zh: 4 示威

Top: the question and the benchmark picker, with gold and evidence documents marked for badging. Below, the trace around a round boundary: a search after the 75% lock is rejected and flagged with the rule it broke; the save closes round one with eight chunks, the sources shown badged as gold documents; round two opens with a fresh context and its first query with the sources it returned.

blocks.en: The harness runs on the server side of a Cloudflare Worker application: it holds the released prompt and tool schemas, enforces the rules of Section 3 , calls the model over an OpenAI-compatible API with the official sampling settings, and journals progress so that a run survives a closed tab and can be stopped. The FP8 checkpoint is served by SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on one serverless H200; GPU and index containers start on demand in under a minute and stop after five idle minutes. The backends are a live web-search API (five snippets per query) and a CPU service over TRuST (324 Russian questions, 2.7M passages) and BrowseComp-Plus (830 English questions, 100k pages), each with the benchmark’s own Qwen3-Embedding-8B index and with BM25. A separate instruct model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; Qwen Team, 2026d , reasoning off) writes the answer last from the ranked snippets through a forced submit_answer tool, with citations verified against observed sources.
blocks.zh: 控制器运行在 Cloudflare Worker 应用程序的服务器侧:它持有释放的即时和工具计数器,执行第3节的规则,在OpenAI与官方采样设置相兼容的API之上调用模型,以及日记进度,以便运行能活过一个被关闭的标签并被停止. FP8检查站由SGLang(Zheng等,2024年)在1个无服务器的H200上服务;GPU和索引容器在1分钟以内按需起动,5分钟闲后停止. 后端为实时网络搜索API(每个查询有5个片段)和TRuST(324个俄语问题,2.7M段)和浏览Comp-Plus(英语问题830个,100k页)的CPU服务,每个有基准自己的Qune3-Embedding-8B指数并带有BM25. 一个单独的指令模型(Quen3.6-35B-A3B;Quen Team, 2026d, exclease off)通过强制提交-答案工具从排名片断中写出最后的答案,其引用语句与被观测到的出处进行校验.

blocks.en: The question box has selectors for the index and a time budget; a corpus index also lists its benchmark questions. The trajectory is a timeline of tool actions split by round dividers: queries with their new chunks and sources, saves with the kept chunks, reasons, and coverage lists, and the final ranking. Rejected actions stay in place, flagged with the rule they broke, and every action opens to its raw arguments and result. Three panels derive from the visible events: context growth (estimated prompt tokens per call against the 32k budget, dropping at each round reset), memory contribution (ranked sources that survived a reset only because the policy saved them), and findings chain (query wording that earlier results supplied, i.e., the bridge entities). For a benchmark question, gold and evidence passages are badged as they arrive and the outcome line reports how many were seen and how many were ranked, the metric of Section 6 for one question; the reference answer can be revealed afterwards, and the model sees neither the badges nor the answer.
blocks.zh: 问题框有指数和时间预算的选择器;一个指数还列出了其基准问题。 轨迹是由圆分隔符分割的工具动作时间表:用它们的新块和源来查询,用所保存的块来保存,理由和覆盖列表,以及最后的排名. 拒绝的行动保持原地,以他们打破的规则为旗号,每一起行动都打开其原始论点和结果。 三个板块来自可见的事件:上下文增长(估计每次呼叫时对32克预算迅速发出信号,每回合重置时下降);内存贡献(仅因为政策拯救了它们,才在重置中幸存的排名出处)和结论链(提供较早结果的平分措辞,即桥梁实体)。 对于一个基准问题,黄金和证据段落在到达时被标出徽章,结果一行报告看到多少人和排名多少人,一个问题的6节的衡量标准;一个问题的参考答案可以在之后被揭示出,模型既没有看到徽章,也没有看到答案.

blocks.en: The screencast replays a completed T-Search run on a BrowseComp-Plus question using the dense index. The policy searches from several angles and gold badges appear as the right passages surface; a save closes the round and the context plot drops back to the saved chunks; finalization returns the ranking, which the outcome line scores against the reference evidence documents, and the answer model writes a cited answer to compare with the reference. The screencast concludes by showing the available search backends and switching to live web search.

blocks.en: 5 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 5 培训辅助工具

blocks.en: We fine-tune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on synthetic search tasks in two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher trajectories and reinforcement learning, both inside the harness of Section 3 . Tasks are generated over local corpora, so the policy is trained in the loop it is evaluated in.
blocks.zh: 我们将Qune3.6-35B-A3B对合成搜索任务进行分两个阶段进行微调:关于教师轨迹的监督微调(SFT)和强化学习,两者都在第3节的利用范围内. 任务是通过本地公司生成的,因此政策在它被评价的回路中得到训练.

blocks.en: Each task contains a question, a short reference answer, annotated support chunks, and a fixed index with distractors. Questions are generated natively in each language rather than translated between them, the same choice Tsymboi et al. (2026) make for Russian function-calling data after finding that native generation matters. A taxonomy specifies the search mechanic, question form, answer type, and distractor properties. Compatible combinations are sampled as generation instructions, with weights adjusted to balance coverage across search behaviors. To support generation with a small local model, we preselect connected chunk subgraphs using named-entity annotations, mention frequencies, and co-occurrence statistics, emphasizing niche entities and less obvious links. Facts are extracted and paraphrased into an intermediate representation; the composer does not see the original quotations, reducing direct lexical clues. It extends a question one hop, entity, or constraint at a time, checking answerability and whether the added support introduces a necessary search step.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都包含一个问题,一个简短的参考答案,附加注释的支持块,以及带有分心器的固定索引. Tsymboi等人(2026年)在发现本土一代很重要后,为俄罗斯函数调用数据做出了同样的选择。 分类学指定了搜索机械师,提问形式,答案类型,以及分心器属性. 相容组合作为生成指令进行采样,并调整权重以平衡搜索行为之间的覆盖. 为了用一个小的本地模型支持生成,我们预先选择了连接的块子图,使用命名实体说明,提及频率,以及并发性统计,强调特殊实体和不太明显的链接. 事实被取出并被译为中间代表;作曲者不见出原引文,减少直接的词典线索. 它延长一个问题,即一次跳出、实体或约束,检查可回答性,以及附加支持是否引入一个必要的搜索步骤。

blocks.en: An adversarial loop then probes shortcuts beyond these local checks. It tests answerability from the full support set, answer or intermediate-entity leakage, closed-book solvability, and direct retrieval of the required evidence using the whole question as a query. Each support chunk is removed in turn to test its necessity, and superfluous chunks are pruned. Finally, the composer model runs as a search agent; answer correctness and evidence recall are used to identify tasks it solves too easily. Checks proceed from cheaper probes to full agent runs. Feedback names the redundant chunk, leaked clue, or successful shortcut query, and the composer revises and resubmits the task. About 40k of 67k candidates survive this process (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 一个对抗的循环,然后探测这些本地检查之外的捷径. 它从全套支持中测试可答性、答案或中间实体的渗漏性、闭库可溶性,以及利用整个问题作为查询直接检索所需证据。 每个支持块被取出以检验其必要性,多余的块被挤出. 最后,作曲模式作为搜索代理运行;回答正确性和证据召回被用于识别它太容易解决的任务. 检查从更便宜的探测器到全员运行 反馈命名了冗余块,被泄露的线索,或成功的快捷键查询,而作曲者修改并重新提交任务. 67克候选人中约有40克活了下来(附录A.

blocks.en: Each language contributes about 8k SFT questions and a separate pool of 2k RL questions. GLM-5.1 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026a ) collects teacher trajectories. Each is split into self-contained rounds: the input contains the question and the harness state at the start of the round; the target contains the round’s search actions and continuation or finalization decision.
blocks.zh: 每种语言都贡献了约8k SFT题和单独的2k RL题集合. GLM-5.1(GLM-5-Team等,2026a)收集了教师的轨迹. 每个回合分为自成一体的回合:输入包含问题和回合开始时的取用状态;目标包含回合的搜索动作和继续或最终决定.

blocks.en: Invalid tool actions are masked from the loss while useful recovery after tool feedback is retained. A save round must add previously unsaved support; finalization rounds are selected by evidence coverage. Productive earlier rounds can therefore be retained when a trajectory ends with poor coverage, preserving useful supervision on difficult questions. Selection balances round number, ending type, task difficulty, task mechanic, and evidence completeness. Frequent cells are capped, while rare useful cells are retained, yielding about 11k rounds per language. A quarter of the mixture targets retriever robustness with semantic, BM25, and hybrid search, varying embedding backends and retrieval depth (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 无效的工具动作会被丢失所掩盖,同时保留工具反馈后有用的恢复. 保存回合必须增加先前未保存的支持;最后回合由证据覆盖范围选定。 因此,在轨迹以低覆盖率而告终时,可以保留早期的生产性轮次,对困难问题保持有益的监督。 选择平衡圆数,结束类型,任务难度,任务机械师,和证据完整性. 频繁的细胞被盖住,而稀有的有用细胞被保留下来,每个语言产生约11克发. 四分之一的混合物以语义、BM25和混合搜索、不同嵌入后端和取回深度的取回器坚固性为目标(附录A.4)。

blocks.en: The RL stage starts from the merged SFT checkpoint and trains on the separate RL question pool for each language. Each trajectory receives a single scalar reward, the recall of the reference support set in the finalized ranking, computed from chunk identifiers without a judge model (Eq. 1 ); there is no separate reward for saving and no per-round shaping. Recall is preferred over precision-based objectives, which in preliminary runs led to premature finalization with incomplete evidence. We optimize with GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; training dynamics and hyperparameters are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: RL舞台从合并后的SFT检查站起发,列车在单独的RL问题池上为每种语言出站. 每个轨迹都得到一个单一的分级奖赏,即从没有法官模型(Eq. 1)的块状识别器中计算得出最终排名中设定的参考支持的召回;储蓄没有单独的奖赏,也没有每轮塑造. 较之精确目标,人们更倾向于回顾这一点,因为初步来说,这些目标导致在证据不全的情况下过早完成。 我们优化了普惠制O(郑等,2025年);培训动态和超参数在附录B中报告。

blocks.en: Each stage is run separately for English and Russian, and the branches are merged back before the next one: DARE ( Yu et al., 2024 ) combines the two SFT branches into the checkpoint that initializes both RL branches, and SLERP ( Shoemake, 1985 ; Goddard et al., 2024 ) combines the two RL branches into the released model (Figure 5 , Appendix B ); the same two-stage structure is used for per-capability experts in Tsymboi et al. (2026) . The release is thus a single bilingual model.
blocks.zh: 每阶段分别为英语和俄语运行,分站在下阶段之前合并回分站: DARE(Yu等,2024年)将两个SFT分站合并入两个RL分站初始化的检查站,而SLERP(Shoemake等,1985年;Goddard等,2024年)将两个RL分站合并入已放出模式(图5,附录B;Tsymboi等(2026年)中,个人能力专家使用相同的两阶段结构. 因此,发行是单一的双语模式。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6. 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate on BrowseComp-Plus, the Seal-Hard subset of SealQA, our Russian translations of both, and our newly constructed TRuST and SynthComp benchmarks. TRuST contains 324 manually authored Russian questions, while SynthComp contains 395 synthetic questions each in English and Russian. Construction, localization, and scoring are detailed in Appendix C , including SynthComp’s separation from training data in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价浏览器Comp-Plus、SealQA的Seal-Hard子集、我们两者的俄文译本以及我们新建的TRuST和SynthComp基准。 TRuST包含有324个手动作曲的俄语问题,而SynthComp则包含英语和俄语的395个合成问题. 建筑、本地化和评分详见附录C,包括SynthComp在附录C.3中与培训数据分离。

blocks.en: For the main comparison, all models search the same fixed corpora with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, without reranking and with search snippets capped at 512 tokens. T-Search and general-purpose baselines, including its base model, use the T-Search harness with a five-round cap. Harness-1 and generative search agents use adapted released harnesses.
blocks.zh: 对于主比较,所有型号都用Quen3-Embedding-8B搜索同一种固定的蝎子,没有重新排队,并用512个令牌封了搜索片段. T-Search和通用基线,包括其基准模型,使用有五轮盖的T-Search吊带. Harness-1和基因搜索剂使用被改造后释放的被带.

blocks.en: The top and middle blocks of Table 1 report final-set Recall@10. The bottom block reports trajectory recall over all unique search results retrieved during a rollout, which is not directly comparable to final-set Recall@10 (Appendix D ). Recall uses reference documents for BrowseComp-Plus and TRuST, annotated evidence chunks for our SealQA adaptation, and all reference evidence chunks for SynthComp. Each score column averages recall over the questions in the corresponding benchmark and language. Avg. is the arithmetic mean of the preceding score columns in Table 1 .

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the main results. At a single rollout, T-Search improves over its base model on every benchmark and achieves the highest average Recall@10 among single-rollout configurations in the T-Search harness (55.96). It outperforms all general-purpose baselines except on Russian BrowseComp-Plus, where GLM-5.1 leads. Fusing three rollouts increases recall on every benchmark and raises the average to 61.33. With fusion, T-Search achieves the highest final-set Recall@10 on all benchmarks. Among the generative agents, Tongyi DeepResearch has the highest average trajectory recall. Recall increases from the base model to SFT and from SFT to the released model on every benchmark (Appendix E , Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 表1列出主要结果。 在一次推出时,T-Search改进了每个基准的基准模型,并在T-Search带(55.96)的单推出配置中实现了最高平均回调@10。 它的性能超过了所有通用基线,但俄罗斯浏览器Comp-Plus上的情况除外,GLM-5.1引出. 采用三次推出会提高每个基准的召回率,并将平均值提高到61.33。 随着核聚变,T-Search在所有基准上都实现了最高的"最终设定回召"(Recall@10). 在基因活性剂中,通义深度研究的平均回溯率最高. 回顾从基准模型到SFT以及从SFT到每个基准上发布的模型的增长(附录E,表3)。

blocks.en: The round cap and the number of fused rollouts control the latency–recall trade-off. Figure 3 varies the round cap over { 1 , 3 , 5 } \{1,3,5\} in the T-Search harness. Latency is measured on 35 questions using a protocol inspired by Chang et al. (2026) , while recall uses all evaluation questions (Appendix E ). In one round, T-Search achieves an average recall similar to Qwen3.5-397B-A17B in five rounds, at 40% of its latency. At three rounds, it approaches GLM-5.1 at five rounds using less than a third of its latency. Parallel rollout fusion further improves recall at the cost of additional inference work.

blocks.en: T-Search supports all tested retrievers with the same checkpoint and agent inference settings ( N = 1 N{=}1 ), including alternative dense retrievers, BM25, and LLM reranking. Average Recall@10 ranges from 49.38 with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B to 62.87 with an LLM reranker on top of the default retriever, compared with 55.96 for the default retriever (Table 2 , Appendix E ). Reranking improves recall on every benchmark. Retriever choice still matters: BM25 performs best on SynthComp and TRuST, but worst on BrowseComp-Plus among the tested retrievers.
blocks.zh: T-Search支持所有经过测试的有相同检查点和代理推论设置(N = 1 N{=}1)的取回器,包括替代的密集取回器,BM25,和LLM重排. 平均回调@10从49.38起为Qune3-Embedding-0.6B到62.87起为默认回调器上方的LLM重排,而默认回调器则从55.96起(表2,附录E.). 重新排位可以提高每个基准的召回率。 检索选择仍然很重要:BM25在SynthComp和TRuST上表现最好,但在测试的检索器中浏览Comp-Plus上表现最差.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: T-Search treats evidence gathering as a component in its own right. A bounded multi-round harness keeps the working window short while the search runs long, a synthetic data factory builds search difficulty into the corpus and verifies that difficulty by trying to shortcut it, and round-sliced SFT followed by GSPO on a recall reward turns a 35B mixture-of-experts into a retriever that averages 56.0 Recall@10 over seven English and Russian benchmarks, 14.4 points above its base under the same five-round cap and ahead of considerably larger open models; three-rollout fusion raises this to 61.3. Because the agent reaches documents only through a tool, practitioners can swap the backend, point the harness at their own index, and keep the generator they already run.
blocks.zh: T-Search将证据收集视为自身的组成部分. 一种有限度的多轮拉带在搜索时间长时保持了工作窗口短促,一个合成数据厂将搜索难度加入实体,通过尝试快捷方式验证这一困难,然后由普惠制O在召回奖励上进行圆切分的SFT,将35B型混合型专家变成一个检索器,平均56.0回调@10超过7个英文和俄文基准,比其基数高14.4分的同一五轮盖下,比大得多的开放型号更早;三回调的组合将这一数值提高到61.3。 因为代理机只能通过一个工具到达文档,从业者可以互换后端,用自己的索引来指向被机,并保持他们已经运行的生成器.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The rounds, the three-tool contract, and the guardrails are what the policy learned to operate inside, so quality can shift in a different loop. We recommend running the released harness and validating on your own index before relying on the reported numbers.
blocks.zh: 轮回,三工具合同,和护栏是政策所学到的在内部操作,因此质量可以在不同的循环中转变. 我们建议在依靠报告的数字之前,先运行释放的带并验证自己的索引。

blocks.en: T-Search returns a ranked evidence set with justifications and leaves generation to a downstream model, which is the intended design but means it cannot be deployed or evaluated as a standalone question-answering system. On general-purpose benchmarks, we did not observe noticeable differences from the base model.
blocks.zh: T-Search返回一个有正当理由的有排名的证据集,并将生成留给下游模型,这是预期的设计,但意味着它不能作为独立的问答系统被部署或评价. 在普通用途基准方面,我们没有观察到与基准模型的明显差异。

blocks.en: Ethical Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en: TRuST questions were written by 15 annotators employed by T-Tech and are grounded in publicly accessible Russian-language web pages. The released index contains 512-token chunks of those pages together with their source URLs, is distributed under ODC-BY for research use, and we honor removal requests from page owners. Every person named in a question or its evidence appears in a public role; we verified this for the whole benchmark after collection. SynthComp-En is built from Essential-Web ( Essential AI et al., 2025 ) , while SynthComp-Ru uses Russian-language sources including FineWeb2 ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) and Russian Wikipedia. The benchmark releases are licensed under ODC-BY; source texts remain subject to their original terms.
blocks.zh: TRuST问题由T-Tech雇用的15名注释员撰写,并以可公开查阅的俄语网页为基础。 发行的索引包含这些页面的512个托肯块及其出处URL,在ODC-BY下分发供研究使用,我们尊重页面所有者的删除请求. 在问题中被点名的每一个人或其证据都出现在公共场合;我们在收集之后核实了整个基准。 SynthComp-En由Basic-Web(Basic AI等,2025年)所建;而SynthComp-Ru则使用俄语来源,包括FineWeb2(Penedo等,2025年)和俄语维基百科. 基准释放根据ODC-BY获得许可;源文本仍须遵守原始条款。

blocks.en: Training tasks, teacher trajectories, and the difficulty checks for TRuST were produced by LLMs (the composer model, GLM-5.1, and GPT-5.4); every task is validated for answerability against its annotated support chunks, which come from the corpus rather than from a model. The per-chunk reasons that T-Search returns are model-generated and can be wrong; they help a reader locate evidence and do not replace reading it.
blocks.zh: 培训任务、教师轨迹和TRuST的难度检查是由LLMS(作曲模式GLM-5.1和GPT-5.4)产生的;每项任务都根据附加说明的支持块加以验证,这些支持块来自本体而不是模型。 per-chunk的T-Search返回是模型生成的,可能是错误的;它们帮助一个读者找到证据,而不是替换阅读.

blocks.en: T-Search returns evidence rather than answers and is optimized for recall, so a returned list can include chunks that turn out not to support the answer; downstream systems must verify claims against the returned text. Like any web search agent, it could be used to aggregate information about individuals. In the public playground the live-web retriever passes the five snippets returned by the search API per query directly to the agent and never fetches page content, so it exposes no information that the underlying search engine does not already return for the same queries; the API’s content policies apply, runs are bounded by the round cap and a time budget, no conversations are stored, and run journals expire after two hours. The released harness lets operators restrict the backend to their own corpus, which is the intended deployment.
blocks.zh: T-Search 返回证据,而不是答案,并被优化用于召回,因此返回的列表可以包含块,结果不支持答案;下游系统必须对照返回的文本来验证索赔. 与任何网络搜索代理商一样,它可以用于汇总个人信息. 在公共游乐场中,现场网络检索器将搜索API每次查询直接返回的5个片段传递给代理商,并且从不获取页面内容,因此它没有暴露任何信息显示基础搜索引擎还没有返回同样的查询;API的内容政策适用,运行受圆顶和时间预算的限制,没有存储对话,运行日记在两个小时后过期. 释放的绳子让操作人员将后端限制在他们自己的体内,这就是打算的部署.

blocks.en: The base model is released under Apache-2.0, and the harness and the released checkpoints, including the FP8 and NVFP4 quantizations, are distributed under the same license; benchmarks are ODC-BY. The model is trained and evaluated only in English and Russian; behavior in other languages is untested. SFT and RL for both languages used four nodes of eight H100 GPUs for about 3k GPU-hours in total; the demo serves one on-demand GPU that stops after five idle minutes.
blocks.zh: 基础模型在Apache-2.0下发布,并用同一张牌照发放了吊带和已放行的检查站,包括FP8和NVFP4的四分法;基准为ODC-BY. 该模型只用英语和俄语进行训练和评价;其他语言的行为未经测试。 两种语言的SFT和RL共使用8个H100GPU的4个节点,总共约3kGPU-hour;演示为1个点播GPU服务,5个闲分钟后停止.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 summarizes the core construction and revision loop.
The reference answer and support annotations serve different purposes: the answer is used to validate the question, while the support set enables evidence-based checks and trajectory selection. The trained retriever returns evidence rather than answer text.
blocks.zh:
图4总结了核心建设和修订环路.
参考答案和支持说明服务于不同的目的:答案用于验证问题,而支持集则能够进行循证检查并选择出轨. 训练有素的检索者返回证据,而不是回答文字。

blocks.en: Taxonomy cells describe intended search behavior, not merely subject matter. For example, linking intermediate entities differs from intersecting independent constraints or gathering candidates for comparison; temporal reasoning and calculations impose further requirements on the supporting facts. Question form, answer type, and distractor properties provide additional controls. Only compatible combinations are supplied to the composer, and sampling weights are adjusted to cover underrepresented combinations. A specification expresses the intended task, but does not establish that its solution actually requires the intended searches. That is tested after composition.
blocks.zh: 分类细胞描述的是预定的搜索行为,而不仅仅是主题. 例如,将中间实体联系起来不同于交叉的独立制约或收集候选人进行比较;时间推理和计算对佐证事实提出了进一步要求。 提问形式,答题类型,和分心器属性提供了额外的控制. 只向作曲家提供相容组合,并调整了采样权重以涵盖代表性不足的组合. 规格表示预定的任务,但并不确定它的解决方案实际上需要预定的搜索. 这是经过成分检验的。

blocks.en: A.2 Corpus-grounded, incremental composition
blocks.zh: A.2 有公司基础的增量成分

blocks.en: The initial exploratory generator, inspired by Context-1 ( Bashir et al., 2026 ) , searched the index for related facts but tended to produce entity-chain questions and choose facts accessible through broad queries or model knowledge. The final pipeline instead prepares candidate subgraphs before question construction. Connections may involve entities, events, dates, or other constraints. Niche facts and less obvious links help reduce trivial starting points, while preselection relieves the small composer of having to discover a suitable factual chain by exploring the entire index.
blocks.zh: 最初的探索生成器受背景1(Bashir等,2026年)启发,搜索了相关事实的索引,但倾向于提出实体链问题并选择通过广泛查询或模型知识可获取的事实。 最后的管道则在质疑施工之前准备候选子图. 连接可能涉及实体,事件,日期或其他限制. 尼切事实和不太明显的链接有助于减少微不足道的起步点,而预选则通过探索整个指数,免除了小作曲家不得不发现合适的事实链.

blocks.en: The composer receives paraphrased facts rather than source quotations. A distinctive phrase copied into a question could itself serve as an effective retrieval query even when the wording appears to require multiple reasoning steps. Paraphrasing reduces this risk but may distort a fact, so correctness is checked against the source support chunks. The intermediate representation is an input to composition, not a replacement for the source evidence used in validation.
blocks.zh: 作曲者接收被诠释的事实,而不是来源引文. 即使措辞似乎需要多个推理步骤,抄入一个问题的独特短语本身也可作为一个有效的检索查询。 缩写可减少这种风险,但可能扭曲一个事实,因此对照源支持块检查正确性。 中间表示是对组成的一种投入,而不是对审定中使用的来源证据的替代.

blocks.en: After each extension, answerability and the necessity of the added support are checked before composition continues. These checks localize a broken chain or unnecessary constraint to an individual extension. Validation of the completed question then attempts to bypass the intended chain. A locally valid extension may still leave a shortcut through the question wording, a broad retrieval query, or facts already known to the model.
blocks.zh: 在每次延期后,在继续组成之前,将检查答复和补充支持的必要性。 这些检查将断链或对个人延伸的不必要的限制定位。 然后验证已完成的问题,试图绕过预定的链条。 本地有效的扩展仍然可能通过问题措辞、广泛的检索查询或模型已经知道的事实留下一条捷径。

blocks.en: A.3 Adversarial validation and revision
blocks.zh: A.3 横向验证和修订

blocks.en: The checks use different inputs and test different failure modes: 1. Full-support answerability. Given the question and all annotated support chunks, a solver must be able to derive the reference answer. This checks that composition and paraphrasing have not produced an unsupported task. 2. Question leakage. The wording is examined for direct or near-direct disclosure of the answer or a key intermediate entity. Revealing an intermediate search target can collapse a multi-step task even if the final answer is not stated. 3. Whole-question retrieval. The complete question is submitted as a search query and the top results are inspected for the required evidence. This tests whether the task can be bypassed by retrieving directly from its wording. 4. Support necessity. Each annotated support chunk is removed separately and answerability is checked again. A chunk that does not affect the tested solver’s ability to answer is pruned instead of being counted as an additional reasoning step. 5. Closed-book solvability. The question is tested without retrieved evidence to identify answers available from model knowledge rather than the intended search process. 6. Agentic difficulty. The composer model attempts the question through the search harness. Answer correctness and evidence recall are examined together to identify tasks that remain too easy. A successful agent run is not by itself the acceptance criterion. Failures return actionable feedback to the composer, such as a support chunk that can be removed or a query that exposes the answer directly. Revised tasks are checked again. The checks are complementary: answerability with all supports does not establish their individual necessity, and failure of the whole-question query does not rule out another shortcut.
blocks.zh: 检查使用不同的输入并测试不同的失败模式: 1. 全面支助可答性。 考虑到这个问题和所有附加说明的支持块,解决者必须能够得出参考答案。 这种检查表明,组成和解释并没有产生一个没有支持的任务。 2. 问题渗漏。 对措辞进行审查,以便直接或近乎直接披露答案或关键中间实体。 揭示一个中间搜索目标即使没有说明最后的答案,也可以崩溃一个多步骤的任务. 3. 全问题检索。 完整的问题作为查询提交,并检查最高结果,以获取所需的证据。 这种测试是否可以通过直接取回其措辞来绕过任务. 4. 支助的必要性。 每个附加说明的支持块被分别去除并再次检查可回答性. 一块不会影响被测试的解答者的回答能力, 5. 闭帐可溶性。 在测试这一问题时,没有从模型知识中,而不是从预定的搜索过程中,找到可以找到的答案的证据。 6. 代理困难。 作曲家模型试图通过"搜索"(search temple)来尝试这个问题. 对正确性和证据召回问题一并进行审查,以确定仍然太容易完成的任务。 成功代理运行本身并不是接受标准。 失败将可操作的反馈反馈给作曲家,例如可以删除的支持块或直接曝光答案的查询. 订正任务再次得到检查。 检查是互补的:所有支持的可答性不能确定个人的必要性,而整个问题查询的失败也不能排除另一个快捷方式.

blocks.en: Support necessity is relative to the tested solver and context. Failure to answer after removing a chunk does not prove global minimality of the support set or the absence of every alternative solution. The aggregate retention count in Section 5 measures the output of the overall process, not the contribution of any single check.

blocks.en: For rounds after the first, the incoming state contains saved evidence with reasons, summaries of earlier rounds, coverage declarations, and the next-round goal (Appendix F.2 ). The retained example therefore includes that state rather than reconstructing the entire preceding tool history. Round boundaries expose the student to initial, intermediate, and terminal search states, and allow selection at a finer granularity than whole trajectories.
blocks.zh: 对于第一轮之后的回合,入选状态包含保存的证据,并附有理由,前几轮的总结,覆盖声明,以及下一轮入球(Appendix F.2. 因此,保留的例子包括该国,而不是重建先前的整个工具历史。 圆边界使学生暴露在初始、中间和终端搜索状态,允许在更细的颗粒度上比整个轨迹进行选择。

blocks.en: An invalid action is excluded from the supervised loss, but the resulting tool error can provide context for a useful correction. The continuation is not automatically discarded because an earlier action was invalid. Additional checks inspect tool-call structure and required arguments and remove looping or unjustifiably long reasoning. Local masking concerns which actions are supervised; round selection concerns whether the remaining search behavior is useful.
blocks.zh: 无效的动作被排除在被监管的损失之外,但由此产生的工具出错可以提供一个有用的校正上下文. 续作不会自动被丢弃, 因为先前的动作无效 。 其他检查检查检查工具调用结构,需要论证,并取消循环或无理冗长的推理。 本地对哪些行动受到监督的隐蔽关切; 回合选择涉及剩下的搜索行为是否有用 。

blocks.en: For a round ending in finalize_ranking , selection considers coverage of the reference evidence in the returned set. A weak terminal round can be removed while useful earlier rounds from the same trajectory remain. Filtering only by a trajectory’s final recall would also discard those productive rounds, biasing supervision toward questions that the teacher can already solve well. The continuation criterion above and finalization coverage are SFT selection statistics; they do not define RL rewards.
blocks.zh: 对于最后敲定的回合_排名,选择考虑返回的一组参考证据的涵盖范围。 较弱的终端回合可以去除,而有用的早期回合仍留在同一轨道上。 只能通过轨迹最后的回弹来过滤, 才能丢掉这些富有成效的回合, 上面的延续标准和最后敲定范围是SFT选择统计;它们没有定义RL奖励.

blocks.en: Initial rounds are common, while later rounds that still acquire useful evidence are rarer. Capping frequent mixture cells and retaining rare useful ones limits the dominance of easy initial states without discarding the latter. Balancing also accounts for task difficulty, search mechanic, and evidence completeness, so round position alone does not determine selection.
blocks.zh: 初发子弹很常见,而后来仍然获得有用证据的后发子弹则较为罕见. 挤压频繁的混合细胞并保留稀有的有用细胞会限制简单初始状态的主导地位而不会抛弃后者. 平衡还考虑到任务难度,搜索机械师,和证据完整性,因此单是圆形位置并不能决定选择.

blocks.en: Retriever variation changes both which evidence is returned and the distribution of search-tool outputs seen during supervision. The collection settings vary the search method, embedding model, and retrieval depth. These data are used during SFT, whereas Appendix E evaluates retriever substitution with the final model held fixed. Section 5 reports question counts, retained round counts, and the robustness-mixture proportion. Checks separating SynthComp from the SFT and RL pools are described in Appendix C.3 .

blocks.en: Exploratory precision/F1 objectives encouraged a conservative policy early in RL: search less, return a small set, and finalize with incomplete evidence. Recall instead rewards finding more of the required support. Precision and F1 remain diagnostics; the harness limits the number of returned chunks, so the output cannot grow without bound. Set-based recall gives no extra credit for returning a required identifier repeatedly. The reward measures evidence coverage, rather than correctness of a downstream generated answer or a preference for a particular ordering of already retrieved reference chunks.
blocks.zh: 探索精度/F1目标鼓励在RL早期采取保守政策:少搜索,还回一小套,并用不完整的证据来完成. 转而回顾,找到更多所需支助是值得奖励的。 精度和F1仍为诊断;取取取被取回的块数量受用限制,因此输出不能无约束地增长. 基于设定的召回,对于反复返回所需的标识符,不给予额外贷记. 奖励措施衡量证据覆盖面,而不是下游生成的答案的正确性,或者倾向于对已经取回的参考块进行特定订购。

blocks.en: Evaluation uses fixed indices rather than live web search, keeping the corpus available to each model fixed during evaluation. BrowseComp-Plus supplies the underlying evaluation methodology. SealQA’s Seal-Hard questions are adapted to a fixed corpus: documents are split into 512-token chunks, which are annotated for whether they provide evidence needed for the answer. Thirty-three questions are removed because their documents lack useful evidence or contradict the reference answer, leaving 221 questions in each of the English and Russian versions.
blocks.zh: 评价使用固定指数,而不是现场网络搜索,使每个模式在评价期间都能使用。 浏览Comp-Plus提供基础评价方法. SealQA的 " Seal-Hard " 问题被修改为固定程序:文件被分割成512块,并附加说明它们是否提供了答案所需的证据。 删去了33个问题,因为他们的文件缺乏有用的证据或与参考答复相矛盾,每个英文和俄文版本都留下了221个问题。

blocks.en: Russian localization has two parts: translating the document corpus and translating question–answer pairs. Translation rules preserve named entities, numbers and units, document structure, formatting, and style. Answering from translated reference texts checks that the evidence still supports the reference answer. Such a check tests preservation of the evidence–answer relation; it does not establish equivalence of retrieval difficulty after translation. Translated tasks also remain distinct from tasks originally constructed from Russian sources, motivating the native Russian collections below.
blocks.zh: 俄罗斯本地化有两部分:翻译文件本体和翻译问答对等. 翻译规则保留被命名的实体,数字和单位,文档结构,格式化,和样式. 从翻译参考文献中回答,证据仍然支持参考文献。 这种对证据-答案关系的保存的检查检验;它并不确定翻译后检索困难的等同性。 翻译的任务也与最初从俄罗斯来源建立的任务不同,促使下文的俄罗斯本土收藏。

blocks.en: C.2 TRuST construction
blocks.zh: C.2 TRuST建筑

blocks.en: TRuST contains 324 manually constructed Russian questions with short, unambiguous answers, created by 15 annotators from Russian-language web sources. Each example follows a hard-to-retrieve, easy-to-verify design: the answer should not be reliably recoverable from model knowledge or a single surface-level search, but should be unambiguously supported once the required evidence is found. The collection covers 8 topics: business and technology, sports, news and politics, science and academic publications, media and arts, regulation and law, geography, and history and archives. Five reasoning categories characterize the search difficulty: connecting multiple sources, using structured evidence, tracking changes over time, disambiguating entities, and comparing candidates. These categories target common challenges of the Russian web, including fragmented evidence, inconsistent entity naming, regional and archived pages, official and legal documents, and information distributed across multiple sites.
blocks.zh: TRuST包含324个人工构建的俄语问题,有简短,毫不含糊的答案,由来自俄语网络来源的15位注释员创建. 每个例子都遵循难以获取,易于验证的设计:答案不应从模型知识或单一地表级搜索中可靠地被取回,而应在找到所需证据后得到明确支持. 该馆藏有8个专题:商业与技术,体育,新闻与政治,科学和学术出版物,媒体与艺术,法规与法律,地理学,历史与档案. 5个推理类是搜索难度的特征:连接多源,使用结构化证据,跟踪随时间推移而发生的变化,混淆实体,比较候选人. 这些类别针对俄罗斯网络的共同挑战,包括零散的证据、不一致的实体命名、区域和存档网页、官方和法律文件,以及在多个网站分发的信息。

blocks.en: Question construction starts from a seed fact or entity. Annotators progressively add properties that narrow the candidate set without directly revealing the answer, and then formulate a natural-language question with a short, definite answer. For each example, they record a final source confirming the answer together with the intermediate sources needed to connect the clues in the question to that answer, preferably across different websites. Questions themselves are authored manually, and LLMs are used only during validation rather than for question generation.
blocks.zh: 问题构建从种子事实或实体开始。 注释者逐渐地添加一些属性,这些属性缩小了候选集,而没有直接揭示答案,然后用一个简短,明确的答案来提出自然语言的问题. 对于每一个例子,它们记录一个最终来源,确认答案,以及将问题中的线索与答案连接起来所需的中间来源,最好是通过不同的网站. 问题本身是手动撰写的,而LLM只在验证时使用,而不是用于问题生成.

blocks.en: Each candidate passes several shortcut and difficulty checks. Annotators search the full question, paraphrased variants, and English reformulations to reject examples whose answer is surfaced directly by simple retrieval. GPT-5.4 independently attempts each question in closed-book, single-query, and full agentic-search settings. Questions solved from model knowledge or with a single-query search are returned for revision. For the agentic setting, we additionally use a 3-minute search-time threshold as a heuristic for selecting difficult examples.
blocks.zh: 每个候选人都会通过几个捷径和困难检查. 注释者搜索整个问题,解说变体,以及英语重写来拒绝其答案直接由简单检索而出的例子. GPT-5.4独立地尝试了每个问题在闭页,单克和全代理搜索设置中. 从模型知识中解出的问题或用一克一克搜索的方法解出的问题被退回修订. 对于代理设置,我们额外使用3分钟的搜索时间阈值作为选择困难例子的热度.

blocks.en: The final 324 questions represent roughly 30% of initially authored candidates, corresponding to approximately 1.1k candidate questions. About 30% are filtered out by the difficulty checks, while a further 40% fail subsequent evidence validation, primarily because the collected sources do not establish all required intermediate connections or provide insufficient evidence to recover the reference answer. Items are retained only when the question, reference answer, and collected evidence form a complete and consistent evidence chain.
blocks.zh: 最后324个问题约占最初提名候选人的30%,相当于大约1.1克候选人问题。 大约30%被困难检查所过滤出,另有40%未能随后验证证据,主要是因为所收集的资料来源没有建立所有所需的中间连接,或者没有提供足够的证据来收回参考答案。 只有在问题、参考答案和收集的证据构成完整和一致的证据链时才保留项目。

blocks.en: For indexing, each collected reference document is split into 512-token chunks, and the subset of chunks containing evidence needed to establish the answer is annotated explicitly. Each question is associated with an average of 6.01 gold documents and 6.32 annotated gold chunks, for 2,047 annotated gold chunks in total.
blocks.zh: 关于索引编制,每个收集的参考文件被分为512个块,包含确定答案所需证据的块的子集被明确注解. 每个问题都与平均6.01个黄金文件和6.32个注解金块有关,总共2 047个注解金块。

blocks.en: Finally, following BrowseComp-Plus, each question is decomposed into subqueries and search-engine results are used to mine hard negatives. These documents are plausible retrieval candidates but do not provide the evidence required to establish the answer, allowing the benchmark to test whether an agent can distinguish genuinely supporting evidence from realistic distractors.
blocks.zh: 最后,在浏览Comp-Plus之后,每个问题被分解为子克并使用搜索引擎结果来进行硬底矿开采. 这些文件是可信的检索对象,但没有提供确定答案所需的证据,使基准能够检验代理人是否能够将真正的证据与现实的分散注意力者区分开来。

blocks.en: C.3 SynthComp in a shared index
blocks.zh: C.3 共享索引中的合成人

blocks.en: SynthComp-En uses Essential-Web ( Essential AI et al., 2025 ) ; SynthComp-Ru draws on Russian web sources including FineWeb2 ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) and Russian Wikipedia. Candidate tasks generated with the training factory are pooled into a shared index for each language and undergo the additional validation described below.
blocks.zh: SynthComp-En使用Basic-Web(Basic AI等,2025年;SynthComp-Ru从FineWeb2(Penedo等,2025年)和俄罗斯维基百科等俄罗斯网络来源取材. 培训厂产生的候选任务被汇总为每种语言的共同索引,并经过下文所述的进一步验证。

blocks.en: A task validated in its original retrieval environment may acquire a shortcut when supports from other questions enter the index. The shared-index check therefore probes the neighborhood of both the original question and the queries from agent trajectories using the evaluation retriever. Candidates are excluded when those probes expose another task’s supports or alternative documents that bypass the annotated evidence chain. The objective is to reduce cases where low annotated-evidence recall would penalize an agent for finding a different valid route. These probes cover the explored queries and retrieved neighborhoods, not every possible query or alternative proof.
blocks.zh: 在其原始检索环境中验证的任务,当来自其他问题的支持输入索引时,可能获得快捷键. 因此,共享索引检查利用评估检索器,对原始问题和代理轨迹的查询进行周边调查。 当这些探测器暴露另一个任务的支持或替代文件绕过附加说明的证据链时,候选人被排除在外. 目的是减少附加说明的低证据召回会惩罚代理人寻找不同有效路线的案件。 这些探测器涵盖了被探索的询问和被检索的邻里,而不是每一个可能的询问或替代证据.

blocks.en: Isolation is an admissibility check rather than a measure of difficulty. An isolated document can still be easy to find from a distinctive clue. Hard negatives are therefore mined again with the same subquery-based approach used for TRuST, and candidates without a sufficiently challenging retrieval neighborhood are removed. Runs of a strong search agent provide evidence-recall scores used to divide questions into three difficulty levels. The final selection balances search mechanic, chain depth, and difficulty, with extra emphasis on harder questions. These levels are relative to the agent used for construction, not universal difficulty labels.
blocks.zh: 隔离是一种接受性检查,而不是衡量困难。 从一个独特的线索中仍然可以很容易地找到一个孤立的文件. 因此,硬底矿再次被开采,采用与TRuST相同的以子克为基础的方法,没有足够挑战性检索区的候选人被清除. 强搜索代理的运行提供了用于将问题分为三个难度等级的证据召回分数. 最后的选择平衡了搜索机械师,链深和难度,并特别强调了更难的问题. 这些水平是相对于用于构造的剂,而不是通用的难度标签.

blocks.en: MinHash ( Broder, 1997 ) compares benchmark question texts with the SFT and RL question pools to remove identical and near-duplicate formulations. Additional overlap checks exclude tasks built on the same combined support sets. The text and support checks target different leakage paths: rewording a question does not necessarily change its underlying task. This separation does not remove the shared-factory relationship. Appendix E therefore also summarizes the results excluding SynthComp-En and SynthComp-Ru.
blocks.zh: MinHash(Broder,1997年)将基准问题文本与SFT和RL问题集合进行比较,去除相同和相近重复的配方. 额外的重叠检查不包括基于同一综合支助组的任务。 文本和支持检查针对不同的渗漏路径:重新定义一个问题并不一定改变它的基本任务. 这种分离并不能去除共享因子关系. 附 录 E因此还总结了不包括SynthComp-En和SynthComp-Ru的结果。

blocks.en: The reference evidence set contains all required chunks, including the gold subset in which the answer itself occurs. Finding that subset alone is insufficient to solve the question: the remaining supports establish constraints and connections that identify the answer. Consequently, headline SynthComp recall uses the entire evidence set, not just the answer-bearing subset.
blocks.zh: 参考证据集包含所有需要的块,包括答案本身发生的黄金子集. 仅找到该子集不足以解决问题:所剩支持建立能识别答案的制约和连接. 因此,标题SynthComp召回使用整个证据集,而不只是包含答案的子集.

blocks.en: Models in the T-Search block share its memory and stopping rules. The remaining blocks evaluate adapted released search-agent harnesses over the same fixed indices, as detailed in Appendix D . TRuST and SynthComp are released with fixed indices.
blocks.zh: T-Search块中的模型共享其内存并停止规则. 如附录D所详述的,其余块对经过调整的释放的搜索代理工具进行了评估,并发布固定索引。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation of search-agent baselines
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价搜索代理基线

blocks.en: For the main comparison in Table 1 , all agents search the same fixed benchmark corpora using Qwen3-Embedding-8B, without reranking or public-web access. Adapters preserve the indexed retrieval units. The text snippet for each search result is capped at 512 tokens, excluding titles and tool-response formatting. For agents supporting visit operations, returned identifiers resolve to local corpus records rather than external URLs. We do not add citation requirements or final-source-selection instructions to generative agents. Each baseline uses one rollout per question.
blocks.zh: 对于表1中的主要比较,所有代理都使用Qune3-Embedding-8B搜索同一固定基准的corpora,没有重新排位或公用网络访问. 适配器保存索引检索单元. 每个搜索结果的文本片段被封为512个令牌,不包括标题和工具响应格式. 对于支持访问业务的代理商,返回的识别器会解决本地实体记录,而不是外部URL. 我们不向基因制剂添加引用要求或最终来源选择指示。 每个基准每个问题都使用一出。

blocks.en:
WebDancer uses the released Qwen-Agent-based search-and-visit loop, with a maximum of 50 model calls and ten search results per query. For WebShaper, we adopt the same WebDancer inference recipe, as we did not identify a separate released WebShaper runner.
Both configurations retain Qwen-Agent’s approximate 58k-token input limit and a maximum of 32,768 output tokens per call.
We serve both models with a 131,072-token context and fourfold YaRN ( Peng et al., 2024 ) scaling to accommodate these limits.
blocks.zh:
WebDancer使用已发布的基于Quen-Agent的搜索和访问回路,每个查询最多有50个模式调用和10个搜索结果. 对于WebShaper,我们采用了同样的WebDancer推论方法,因为我们没有确定一个单独发布的WebShaper跑道.
两种配置都保留了Quen-Agent大约58k-token的输入限制,每次调用最多为32,768个输出令牌.
我们为两种型号服务,其上下文为131,072-token,上下文为4倍YARN(Peng等,2024年)以适应这些极限.

blocks.en: WebSailor uses its released tagged-text search-and-visit loop, with a 40-call budget and a native 32,768-token context without YaRN. We retain its context-limit finalization procedure which may add a final generation.
blocks.zh: WebSailor 使用其已发布的被标记的文本搜索和访问环路,其预算为40个调用,且没有YARN的本地上下文为32,768个调用. 我们保留其限定背景的定稿程序,这可能会增加最后一代人。

blocks.en: We use the released ReAct inference configuration. The available tools are local search and visit; Python execution, scholarly search, and file parsing are not exposed. The budgets are 100 model calls, 150 minutes per episode, and at most 10k output tokens per call. The model uses its native 131,072-token context without YaRN and retains context-triggered finalization.
blocks.zh: 我们使用发布的ReAct推论配置. 现有的工具是本地搜索和访问; Python 执行、学术搜索和文件解析没有曝光。 预算为100个模式调用,每集150分钟,每集最多10克输出令牌. 该模型使用其没有YARN的原生上下文131,072-token,并保留了上下文触发的定稿.

blocks.en:
Following the WebSailor setup, we use Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for goal-conditioned extraction from visited corpus records.
All four Alibaba agents access the same auxiliary-model service. The helper uses a native 32,768-token context, with at most 24k input tokens including the visit goal and prompt formatting, and 8,192 output tokens.
Long records are truncated to fit the input budget. Decoding uses temperature zero and top- p p one.
T-Search uses no auxiliary language model.
blocks.zh:
在WebSailor设置后,我们使用Quen2.5-72B-指令从被访问的案卷中以入门条件取出.
4名阿里巴巴特工都获得同样的辅助-模型服务. 帮助器使用原生的32,768个token上下文,最多有24k个输入符,包括访问目标与即时格式化,以及8,192个输出符.
长记录被截取以符合投入预算. 解码使用温度0和上 -- p 1.
T-Search没有使用辅助语言模型.

blocks.en:
We retain the released Harmony interaction protocol, stateful evidence curation, and a 40-step runtime limit. Verification uses the author’s unavailable-tool ablation: the verifier remains in the tool schema but returns an unavailable message without invoking a verifier model. Reranking and the downstream answer generator are disabled. The internal curated set retains its 30-item cap; our final export selects at most ten items by importance, breaking ties by insertion order.
For long-record reads, the adapter supplies a prefix of at most 4,096 tokens including a truncation marker. This avoids the upstream behavior of dropping an oversized record entirely. Like T-Search, the evaluated Harness-1 configuration uses no auxiliary language model.

We evaluate PeterJinGo/SearchR1-nq_hotpotqa_train-qwen2.5-32b-em-grpo-v0.3 using the released search loop adapted to a completions endpoint.
It permits four search-capable generations followed by a final generation, uses greedy decoding with at most 500 output tokens per call, and maintains a rolling 4,096-token input. Each search returns three results, and the complete search observation is additionally truncated to 500 tokens. Search-R1 uses neither visit nor an auxiliary model.

blocks.en: Appendix F.1 presents the released function schemas as field tables and their original descriptions. The following paragraphs describe runtime validation and state transitions. The harness returns error feedback for invalid tool calls and rejects plain-text replies when a tool action is required. Validation checks tool names, arguments, and transition conditions. During SFT such invalid actions are masked from the loss while the continuation is kept (Section 5 ). The default per-round budget is 32,768 tokens, and the default round cap is five. The latency study varies the round cap while retaining the same transition rules.
blocks.zh: 附录F.1以字段表及其原始描述的形式介绍已发布的函数计划。 以下段落描述运行时间验证和状态过渡. 调用返回无效工具调用的错误反馈, 当需要工具动作时拒绝纯文本回复 。 校验工具名称、参数和过渡条件。 在SFT期间,这种无效动作在保留续作的同时被掩盖为损失(第5节)。 每轮预算的默认值为32,768个令牌,而默认的回合上限为5个. 耐久性研究在保留相同的过渡规则的同时,会改变圆顶.

blocks.en: At 75% context utilization, further search calls are locked, leaving continuation or finalization. A save_and_advance transition requires at least five searches and at least one saved chunk with an explanation. The five-search condition governs a round transition, not all final answers: a task solved earlier can finalize without making five queries. Saving is disabled in the last allowed round.
blocks.zh: 在75%的上下文使用率下,会锁定进一步的搜索电话,从而继续或完成搜索。 保存_ 和_ 提前过渡需要至少 5 个搜索和至少 一个带解释的保存块 。 5-搜索条件规范了回合过渡,并非所有最终答案:较早解决的任务可以在不提出5个询问的情况下完成. 保存在最后一个允许的回合被禁用 。

blocks.en: For saving and finalization, the model supplies lists of covered and unresolved question parts. Outside the final round, finalization is rejected if at least half remain unresolved. This checks the submitted coverage state; it does not independently verify the truth of the model’s coverage assessment. In the last round, the agent must return its best available evidence even if the question remains partly unresolved.
blocks.zh: 为节省和最后确定,示范用品清单列有已涵盖和尚未解决的问题部分。 在最后一轮谈判之外,如果至少一半仍未解决,则最后敲定将被拒绝。 这项调查检查了所提交的覆盖范围状态;没有独立核实模型覆盖范围评估的真相。 在最后一轮中,即使问题部分仍未解决,代理人必须归还其现有的最佳证据。

blocks.en: The harness rejects repeated queries differing only in case or whitespace. It also filters results already seen in the current round and chunks already carried in the context. A chunk seen in a previous round but not preserved may be retrieved again: the earlier decision to discard it does not permanently exclude it. These rules suppress unproductive repetition while allowing the agent to revisit earlier evidence after its search direction changes.
blocks.zh: 吊带拒绝重复的询问 仅在大小写或空白处不同 它还过滤本回合已经看到的结果和上下文中已经携带的块。 上一回合所见但未保存的块可再次取回:早先决定丢弃它并不永久排除它。 这些规则禁止非生产性地重复,同时允许代理人在搜索方向改变后重新审视早先的证据.

blocks.en: The released harness truncates the exported ranking to max_results , which defaults to ten. If no finalize_ranking call is accepted, it starts from the persistent saved set in insertion order and fills remaining positions with globally seen chunks ordered by cached retrieval score. The fallback can therefore include chunks from earlier rounds that were not preserved in the current context.
blocks.zh: 释放的带将导出排位调为 max_results , 默认为 10 。 如果不接受最后定点调用_ 排名调用, 则从连续保存的集起, 按插入顺序排列, 并用全球可见的块来填补剩余位置, 按缓存的检索分数排序 。 因此,退后部分可以包括以前回合中未在当前背景下保留的块。
